name: Journey 1969: Tanjong Pagar Station
summary:
**Relive a Lost Era of Rail Travel**

Tanjong Pagar Railway Station was more than a transit point. It was a place of arrivals and departures, reunions and farewells, connecting Singapore to the rest of the Malay Peninsula.

This VR experience transports you back to the 1960s, when the station was filled with travellers, vendors, station staff, and families sending off their loved ones.
